# MarketNow MCP

> Free trust layer for AI agents using MCP (Model Context Protocol). Verify credentials, check domains, fingerprint tools — before your agent executes anything. 100% free, no signup, no API keys.

Docs:
- Quickstart + client configs: README.md
- Full package + API reference: llms-full.txt
- Guided install for Cline: llms-install.md

Key facts:
- Remote MCP endpoint (JSON-RPC, streamable HTTP, zero install): https://www.marketnow.site/api/mcp
- Version: marketnow-mcp 1.13.0 — protocol 2025-03-26 — 9 tools
- Free scam-check API: https://www.marketnow.site/api/scam-check?url=DOMAIN
- CA public key (ATC verification): https://www.marketnow.site/api/atc?action=ca-key
- Registry size: 68,388 indexed MCP servers
- Credential formats: 8 (ATC v3, JWT, W3C VC, A2A, EAT-AI, ZTA, MCP Card, X.509)
- Verification pipeline: 12 stages, fail-closed
- npm: 14 packages, ~6,300 downloads/month (lead: marketnow-mcp, agent-trust-card)
- One-shot installer: curl -fsSL https://marketnow.site/install.sh | bash
- Site: https://www.marketnow.site — catalog: /catalog — submit: /submit
- Canonical development repo: https://github.com/alicelabs-llc/universal-trust-adapter

Tools (remote endpoint):
- marketnow_verify_trust: verify any of 8 credential formats
- marketnow_translate_credential: convert between formats
- marketnow_list_formats: formats + algorithms + status
- marketnow_get_pipeline: the 12 verification stages
- marketnow_check_domain: risk score + reasons for any domain
- marketnow_search_skills: search 68k+ MCP servers
- marketnow_check_revocation: ATC card_id / CA kid revocation status
- marketnow_fingerprint_tool: cryptographic hash of MCP tool definitions
- marketnow_submit_skill: publish to the MarketNow catalog (Sentinel-scanned)

Optional:
- Everything is free by design: no per-call fees, no ledger rent, no paid tier gating trust.
